description.value: Blue Mountain Vineyard and Cellars is a family-owned estate winery in Okanagan Falls that has been producing cool-climate wines since 1991, with all grapes grown on a single contiguous site farmed by the Mavety family for nearly 50 years. The winery focuses on minimal-intervention, terroir-driven wines — sparkling, Pinot Blanc, Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Gris, and reds — with hand-picked, gravity-racked fruit. Tastings are reservation-only and the winery hosts occasional events at the estate and around the broader Okanagan region.
